- Heavy-duty black rubber cable, waterproof
- Connectable up to 50m for custom lighting

Whether you choose to install them permanently or bring them out for special occasions, these Warm White Icicle Lights are designed to deliver long-lasting performance and an inviting glow that transforms any space.
